provenance.authoredBy: Homeplate Group 6, drafted with AI assistance (Claude Code) under team direction
provenance.method: Items written for this repository against the FR-08 taxonomy and the Homeplate v1.0 surfaces (listing text, review text, private message, host profile bio). No item is copied or adapted from a real user, a real platform, or a third-party dataset. Names, handles, domains and phone numbers are fictional and use reserved example ranges.
provenance.authoringNote: ADR-008 rejects deferring the set until after the pipeline exists, so this set was authored before the U4-MODERATION pre-filter and classifier prompt were written. Later versions must be new directories (v2, v3), never edits to a measured set.

metricDefinitions.falsePositive: An item labelled 'benign' that the pipeline classifies as any violating category.
metricDefinitions.falseNegative: An item labelled offensive, spam or fraudulent that the pipeline classifies as 'benign'.
metricDefinitions.misrouted: A violating item classified as a different violating category. Not counted as a false positive or a false negative under NFR-10's binary bound, but reported because FR-08 routing depends on the category.
metricDefinitions.resolution: With 56 benign items one benign misclassification moves the false-positive rate by 1.79 points, so the bound is decided by at most 2 (pass) versus 3 or more (fail) misclassified benign items. With 168 violating items one miss moves the false-negative rate by 0.60 points.

labelPolicy.dominantViolation: An item that violates more than one category is labelled by the most severe violation, using severityOrder (offensive > fraudulent > spam).
labelPolicy.spamVersusFraudulent: Untargeted promotion, link farming, keyword stuffing and bulk outreach are 'spam'. Content that tries to obtain money, credentials, identity documents or personal data from a specific person by deception is 'fraudulent'.
labelPolicy.paymentsAreOutOfScope: Homeplate v1.0 moves no money (SRS 1.2), so arranging ordinary cash payment on the night is benign. A demand for an upfront transfer, gift card, crypto or card details is fraudulent because no such platform flow exists to justify it.
labelPolicy.criticismIsBenign: Negative reviews, food-safety complaints, allergen complaints and reports of abuse are benign, including when they quote the abusive words. Moderating these away is the false positive NFR-10 is meant to bound.
labelPolicy.abuseTargetsPeople: 'offensive' requires abuse, hate, threats, sexual harassment or demeaning language directed at a person or group. Strong language about food is not offensive.

labelReview.note: ADR-008 label sign-off: a human team member reviewed the 224 AI-proposed labels against the boundary rules in MANIFEST.md and signed off, reported by the reviewer and transcribed by the build agent at their instruction (an agent may not perform this review). The sign-off unlocks CLAIMABILITY only: an NFR-10 pass still additionally requires a real IT-03 run through a LIVE classifier (never the mock, ADR-007) with the model id and prompt version recorded in RESULTS.md, and both measured rates below 0.05. Correcting a label after a recorded IT-03 run requires a new set version v2/, not an edit here.
